flows.title: Mood Disorders — Depressed Mood

nodes.t: Rule out depressed or elevated mood disorder due to substances and/or general medical condition
nodes.d:
Medical Conditions

  • Neurological: C.V.A, Parkinson’s, MS
  • Viral: Mononucleosis, HIV, Hepatitis
  • Endocrine: Cushing’s, Hyper/hypothyroid
  • Other: Cancer, B12 deficiency

Drugs of Abuse: Amphetamines, Alcohol, Cocaine

Medications: Corticosteroids, Antihypertensives, Antipsychotics, Oral contraceptives
กล่องเส้นประในเล่ม — ดูแผนผัง "Elevated Mood" (flow ถัดไป)

Criteria: 2 week period, depressed mood nearly everyday

  • Depressed Mood
  • Sleep changes
  • Interest – anhedonia
  • Guilt
  • Energy – anergia
  • Concentration - decrease
  • Appetite +/- 5% body weight in one month
  • Psychomotor agitation or retardation
  • Suicidal thoughts

Suicide = 15% over lifetime

Depressed mood more days than not for > 2 years

2 or more:

  1. Decreased appetite
  2. Insomnia
  3. Anergia
  4. Poor concentration
  5. Hopelessness
  6. Low self-esteem

Prevalence = 3% over lifetime

Depressed mood in context of specific stressor < 6 months

Prevalence = 5% hospitalized patients

Depressed mood in context of personal loss < 2 months

None of:

  1. Suicidal ideation
  2. Psychosis (except hallucinations of deceased)
  3. Guilt (except deceased)

nodes.t: Elevated Mood with or without Depressed Mood

nodes.d:
Manic Episode (may have hx of ≥ 1 MDE)

MANIA: 1 week elevated or irritable mood

PLUS 3 or more:

  1. Grandiosity
  2. Decreased sleep
  3. Pressure of speech
  4. Flight of ideas
  5. Distractibility
  6. Increase in goal directed activity
  7. Excessive pleasureable but harmful activities

Suicide = 15% over lifetime

Hypomanic Episode (must have hx of ≥ 1 MDE)

HYPOMANIA: No marked impairment, no psychosis, no hospitalization. At least 4 days.

PLUS 3 or more:

  1. Grandiosity
  2. Decreased sleep
  3. Pressure of speech
  4. Flight of ideas
  5. Distractibility
  6. Increase in goal directed activity
  7. Excessive pleasureable but harmful activities

2 Years Hypomanic Episodes and Depressed Mood
